annotations.title: Recalculate — re-run the engine over the data

description: Recalculate — re-run the deterministic engine over the POS data, dispatching every row against the agreement(s) so rows that just became eligible (e.g. after a data fix or a rule change) accrue. Posts provisional accruals (the same engine compute_close uses); rows that already have a positive accrual are skipped (idempotent). Pass agreement_id to recompute ONE agreement, or omit it to recompute ALL active agreements. Returns the events created and the accrual total. Requires a connected Aurgus account.

agreement_id.description: Recompute just this agreement. Omit to recompute all active agreements.

name: recalculate
